propositions: Author guides reference Success Criteria vocabulary that no longer exists after epic 1386 collapsed Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria into unified Acceptance Criteria

The leaf-vs-container distinction must be re-expressed in terms of child decomposition and coverage requirement rather than the Success Criteria heading that was the only place the split was documented
grep searches for success-criteria vocabulary in guides and docs must return zero matches, with explicitly named carve-outs for generic English usage and deferred definition-of-done concepts

The container guidance section must remain substantive and specify the actual container requirement (child decomposition covering parent acceptance criteria, testing deferred to children) rather than collapsing to a vacuous statement that containers need Acceptance Criteria like all tickets
